_meta.purpose: Per-task eligibility reasoning, extracted for quick audit without re-reading the full task catalog's prose fields.

eligibility.reason: 2000 records with objective ground truth (agent_output.is_correct) and a retained confidence signal; exceeds minimum_sample_requirement of 500.
660 records, exceeds minimum of 300; discrimination ceiling is low (AUROC 0.659) but the task IS evaluable — a near-chance result is still a valid, reportable evaluation, distinct from NOT_EVALUABLE.

Can simulate a post-hoc policy over agreement_rate and score against is_correct, but 0 real ABSTAIN/RETRY decisions exist in ingested sources — cannot evaluate a REALIZED abstention policy's actual downstream effect.
Same structural limitation as ABST-ARITH, compounded by the family's own near-chance discrimination ceiling bounding any achievable improvement.
Same structural limitation as ABST-ARITH; n=400 near the minimum threshold.
0 resource_unavailable-labeled per-episode records exist in the canonical dataset; the STRONG_EVIDENCE verdict is aggregate-only.
Only 10 PROCESS_OOM per-episode records, far below the 300-sample minimum; the AUROC 0.780 verdict and its false-alarm-rate context are aggregate-only.
13 GENERIC_FAIL + 11 NETWORK_FAILURE per-episode records, below minimum and without a dedicated 'flaky' label.
46 controlled_runtime records support a coarse evaluation, but per-failure-class n is small (several classes <30, one n=1) and no independent causal ground truth exists beyond failure_class matching.
34 NOT_RECOVERED + 1 UNKNOWN validation_status records exist, but the historical per-action (RECONFIGURE vs RETRY, n=40 each) comparison is not re-derivable at that scale from this dataset alone.
3,104 distinct workloads across 3,106 episodes means essentially no repeated-workload_id structure exists; no memory-write timestamps exist at all.
Exactly 1 represented environment (UNSPECIFIED_PRE_4_9) across all 3,106 records; no per-episode environment_id exists to construct a dev/held-out/robustness comparison.
Only the 46 controlled_runtime records exercise the full 8-stage loop; agent_task records (3,060) do not exercise diagnosis/recovery/memory at all.
